row:
Welcome to the channel where massage therapy meets real-life pain relief.

I’m Wendee, a Licensed Massage Therapist with over two decades of experience working with athletes, chronic pain clients, and everyday people who just want their bodies to feel normal again.

This channel is dedicated to helping you understand your body, relieve pain, and move better. I also share professional insights for massage therapists who want to build long, sustainable careers in the field.

Expect videos on:
• Neck and shoulder pain solutions
• Muscle release techniques
• Injury recovery and mobility
• Therapist longevity and self-care
• Real stories from the massage table

New videos weekly.

Subscribe and start learning how to take care of your body the right way.
